gen-fs-expose-gf-gafata: Expose is tightly packed, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so headings arrive in a compressed, striking rush. Gafata takes over with a plain sans body, a tall band of letters with a wide-eyed e, and lets the text breathe.
gen-fs-expose-gf-geist: Geist is a quiet plain sans with no accents of weight, its curves opening as wide as a sprung paper clip, while Expose above it varies its stroke. Words land as solid blocks, so a long passage moves along steadily.
gen-fs-expose-gf-georama: Georama reads as approachable sans-serif, its c pulled open like a bracelet and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Under Expose's compressed, refined headings, a long passage settles into an easy stride.
gen-fs-expose-gf-gidole: Sharp, tight, almost neon. Expose crowds its letters into a striking display line, and Gidole answers with a monoline stroke, open terminals and a high-set midline, which is the pair's clearest gap: compressed drama above, a tidy plain sans below.
gen-fs-expose-gf-golos-text: Expose compresses its refined display letters with almost no pause between x-height and caps, while Golos Text fills the line with a big x-height. One brings drama, the other brings steady stems.
gen-fs-expose-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachably, its small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals and each c left clearly open. Hedvig Letters Sans is the relaxed half here, giving the striking, compressed Expose a counterweight that feels friendly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-heebo: Expose delivers striking, tightly spaced display headings where lowercase nearly meets the caps, a refined squeeze of a font. Heebo supplies a tall central band and curves that stop short, a plain sans that handles the text work.
gen-fs-expose-gf-hind-guntur: Tight, striking and a bit theatrical, Expose runs its heading letters close with hardly a pause. Hind Guntur follows as a plain sans with ruler-straight strokes and wide curve gaps, so a long passage reads cleanly and steadily.
gen-fs-expose-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai draws every stroke like neon tubing, wide-mouthed s curves included. Under Expose's compressed, refined display lines, a long passage runs smoothly, its lowercase filling the line almost like capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-hind-mysuru: Expose packs its striking, refined display letters together, with barely any gap between lowercase and caps, while Hind Mysuru keeps a monoweight stroke throughout. That sans-serif body, with its slightly ajar a, lets a long passage glide along.
